decisive_items: Within 2 weeks of starting ipilimumab treatment, she developed skin symptoms
response.rationale: Classic dermatomyositis skin and muscle findings with elevated CK, temporally linked to ipilimumab, favor drug-induced dermatomyositis over isolated dermatomyositis or dermatitis.

rejected.why: Lacks the drug-trigger context and biopsy contradicts inflammatory myositis.
ANA alone is nonspecific; no other lupus features.
Biopsy without inflammation and skin findings point away from polymyositis.
Skin-only reaction cannot explain myositis and elevated CK.
